title: account_qr_code_emv — Thai PromptPay / EMV QR Code Generation on Invoices

key_findings.emv_tag_structure: TLV serialization: 2-digit tag + 2-digit length + value; CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE appended as tag 63 with 4-hex-digit checksum
key_findings.qr_payload_tags: 00=payload format, 01=initiation method (12=dynamic), 29=TH merchant account info, 52=MCC, 53=currency, 54=amount, 58=country, 59=merchant name (max 25), 60=city (max 15), 62=additional data
key_findings.mobile_encoding: leading 0 replaced with 66 (TH country code), zero-padded to 13 digits
key_findings.currency_tag53: THB maps to numeric code 764; resolved dynamically from CURRENCY_MAPPING dict in const.py
key_findings.qr_image_size: 128x128 PNG via ir.actions.report.barcode(), base64 data URI in invoice PDF
key_findings.display_toggle: res.company.qr_code Boolean; no per-journal toggle; suppressed if amount_residual == 0
key_findings.l10n_th_dependency: l10n_th declares account_qr_code_emv as first dependency; auto_install=['account']
key_findings.currency_restriction_th: Only THB allowed for Thai EMV QR; other currencies raise UserError
key_findings.include_reference: opt-in Boolean on res.partner.bank; populates tag 62 if True; base _get_additional_data_field returns None (no TH override)
